annotations.title: UK car models ranked by first-time MOT pass rate

description: Ranks UK car models by first-time MOT pass rate with tests counted and average mileage at test, from DVSA anonymised MOT data under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Pass rates depend heavily on the age and mileage of the cars tested, so the ranking is not a like-for-like comparison. Optional: limit (default 20, max 120) and order ("highest" or "lowest").

limit.description: How many models to return (default 20, max 120)
